content:
Winged drones that can transform into spheres are very advanced crafts that can and should be called UFOs. They use plasma propulsion, they can also switch that plasma around them on and off, and that's why we think the crafts are shape-shifting.  #UFOtwitter #UFOx

This is something that both nations, the US and Russia, are working on, and have patents from their respective aerospace companies, Raduga and Lockheed Martin.

My conclusion is that most of these sightings are being made by highly advanced drones from the United States and Russia.
